plan: My private value of $35 is higher than the maximum possible value ($20) for other bidders, ensuring a win if I bid above $20. To maximize profit, I'll bid slightly above $20, say $20.1, to secure a win while minimizing payment. This ensures a positive profit of at least $14.9, considering the worst-case scenario where the second-highest bid is $20.

The worst-case scenario is losing to a higher bid, but since my value is significantly high, a bid of $40.9 ensures I win if others bid lower. Bidding too high reduces profit, and too low risks losing. Thus, $40.9 is optimal, balancing risk and reward.
